name: Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by National Privacy Commission (privacy.gov.ph) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within National Privacy Commission (privacy.gov.ph).
